niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: Confidential PAS discount agreed; restricted to specialist weight-management clinics.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: Massive latent demand, but NHS England prescribing is tightly gated by Tier 3 specialist clinic capacity rather than drug price alone. Commercial winners pair supply guarantees with digital Tier 3 triage capacity.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: Tier 3 specialist clinic waitlists (14–22 months) & 2-year stopping rule

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: Primary care GP prescribing phased by BMI + comorbidity cohorts over initial 3 years.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: Unlocking GP primary-care prescribing bypassed the Tier 3 clinic bottleneck that slowed Wegovy. Even under phased NHS cohort caps, prescribing velocity is outpacing NICE Year-1 Resource Impact estimates.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: ICB primary-care wraparound lifestyle funding & phased eligibility gates

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: Central NHS England commercial population deal with fixed primary-care price.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: Twice-yearly injection fits primary care nurse clinics, but early GP uptake lagged due to BMA workload disputes over lipid monitoring. Now compounding steadily where ICB lipid pathways automate recall.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: Primary-care nurse administration capacity & GP locally commissioned fee variance

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: Confidential PAS; high adoption across NHS Trust ophthalmology injection suites.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: Textbook NHS commercial execution: extended 16-week dosing directly saves overwhelmed NHS ophthalmology clinic appointments, motivating hospital trusts to switch rapidly from older anti-VEGF injections.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: Minimal — clinic slot savings offset drug acquisition cost in Trust business cases

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: Oral CDK4/6 adjuvant early breast cancer setting; PAS confidential discount.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: Oral administration avoids NHS chemotherapy chair bottlenecks, allowing rapid adoption across regional cancer alliances once MDT pathology protocols updated Ki-67 / nodal risk criteria.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: Early diarrhoea-monitoring nurse phone follow-up capacity in smaller DGH trusts

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: CDF managed access pending longer OS follow-up; Blueteq prior approval mandatory.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: Strong clinical demand in 4th-line myeloma, but step-up dosing requires inpatient CRS monitoring beds. Tertiary hubs are capturing share while district hospitals refer slowly due to bed-day pressure.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: Inpatient haematology step-up dosing bed capacity & tocilizumab stocking rules

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: Homecare delivery subcut maintenance after initial IV induction in Crohn’s disease.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: Outperforming NICE baseline projections in Crohn’s disease because homecare self-injection frees IBD infusion suites and delivers lower 12-month loss-of-response switch rates than legacy anti-TNFs.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: Mild — adalimumab biosimilar step-therapy rules in conservative ICBs

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: CYP2C19 genotyping & serial echocardiogram monitoring required prior to initiation.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: First-in-class precision cardiology win, yet real-world NHS uptake is roughly half NICE’s initial estimate because NHS Trusts face 16-week diagnostic echocardiogram and pharmacogenomic testing backlogs.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: NHS Trust echocardiogram backlog & CYP2C19 genotyping turnaround delays

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: Broad CKD & HFrEF primary care adoption supported by NHS QOF indicators.

niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: Low — upcoming patent cliff increases focus on fixed-dose combinations

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: 6-weekly 400mg dosing option cuts aseptic pharmacy & infusion chair time by 50%.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: Moving from 3-weekly to 6-weekly infusions became a major operational differentiator for NHS aseptic units, protecting market share against newer immunotherapy entrants.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: Aseptic compounding capacity in smaller regional cancer centres

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: Restricted after ≥3 prior preventive treatments fail; oral wafer avoids CGRP mAb training.
niceDrugs.commercialTakeaway: High patient preference for an oral CGRP wafer, yet ICB formulary committees gatekeep GP prescribing behind neurology outpatient sign-off, creating sharp postcode disparities across England.
niceDrugs.payerFrictionFactor: ICB Shared Care Protocol delays requiring secondary-care headache clinic initiation

niceDrugs.commercialAccessNote: Non-eosinophilic severe asthma eligibility expands biologic addressable NHS cohort.
